reasoning: The divergence survives. The controlling language is unqualified: “Refunds open at deadline.” (target/DESIGN.md:L2). The same line defines the refund outcome as one that “pays 100% per entry and returns prize,” so the zero-entry path is not outside the requirement merely because no ticket reimbursement is owed: returning the prize is expressly part of that outcome. DESIGN.md contains no empty-raffle, sponsor, or trusted-actor exception. Indeed, the implementation separately documents its additional policy—“Also closes an empty raffle immediately for the sponsor” (target/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffle.sol:L322-L324)—and implements it by bypassing the pre-endTime guard for the sponsor, entering `Refunding`, and permitting prize return (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L279-L300,L395-L406). That code-side exception cannot narrow the controlling DESIGN.md requirement. Because the sold-Active and Drawing paths do honor their deadlines inclusively while this reachable sponsor path does not, `partial` remains the correct verdict.
